headline: Exploited flaws in VMware vCenter, Drupal and MONAI Label need patching
plain_summary: Several software flaws are being used in real attacks, including VMware vCenter, Drupal and a medical imaging tool. Vendors have released fixes for most of them, and US agencies have set deadlines of 26 and 27 November for some. A suspected Chinese espionage group is linked to the vCenter attacks, but Google names no victims. Organisations running these products should patch now.

items.title: VMware vCenter zero-day exploited since September
items.why: Google says a suspected PRC-nexus espionage actor has exploited an unauthenticated vCenter authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123890) since early September.
items.action: Apply Broadcom's patches (8.0 U3m, 9.0.2.0200, 9.1.1.0200) and restrict inbound and egress access to vCenter; 7.0 has no public patch.

items.title: MONAI Label zero-day exploited; CISA deadline 26 Nov
items.why: Amazon reports AI agents exploited a path traversal flaw in MONAI Label and gained root on a server; the flaw is on CISA's list.
items.action: Update MONAI Label to 0.8.6 or later per advisory GHSA-qc22-rmgc-vg94.

items.title: N-able Mail Assure server accessed; CISA deadline 26 Nov
items.why: N-able says one hosted server was accessed and found no evidence customer data was compromised; a related SSRF flaw, CVE-2026-134624, is under a CISA deadline.
items.action: SpamExperts Local Cloud operators should confirm build 20261121.1943; Hosted Cloud users have nothing to install.

items.title: Drupal core flaw exploited on live sites
items.why: Drupal says a flaw in install.php can allow site takeover and was reported exploited from 19 November; CISA's deadline is 27 Nov.
items.action: Update Drupal core to 10.6.22, 11.3.22 or 11.4.13, or secure the installer as Drupal describes.

items.title: Unpatched Idunno.AntiCsrf library exploited
items.why: Mandiant says exploitation of CVE-2026-131914 is observed, and the project is defunct with no official patch.
items.action: Stop using Idunno.AntiCsrf, replace it, and audit Web.config files and bin/ directories for references to it.

items.title: Optimizely script injection reaches 178+ sites
items.why: Krebs, citing Report URI, reports at least 178 organizations were affected; Optimizely says the flaw is fixed; CISA's deadline is 27 Nov.
items.action: Check Optimizely projects for code injected on 16 November and audit project modifications made while the malicious code was available.

items.title: GT13 campaign hits Check Point management servers
items.why: GreyNoise says the actor reached at least 22 organizations between 17 October and 2 November; the event is still developing.
items.action: Install Check Point's jumbo hotfix for CVE-2026-16232 and limit management and GUI client access to trusted IP addresses.

items.title: South Korea drafts no-fault liability for digital asset operators
items.why: A draft law would make operators liable for user losses from hacking even without fault, with a surcharge capped at 10% of sales.
